description: Create a Stripe Checkout link to subscribe to a plan or buy more AI credits. Nothing is charged until the user pays on the Stripe page. Plans: plus, pro, max (with interval monthly or yearly) and ai_credits (1,000-credit packs, needs a plan). Workspaces on credit billing (billing.credit_billing in get_setup_status) use credit_plan or credit_top_up instead. Confirm the choice with the user first. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

interval.description: Billing interval for plus, pro or max. Defaults to monthly.

quantity.description: Number of 1,000-credit packs for ai_credits. Defaults to 1.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

name: create_checkout_link
title: Create a Stripe checkout link
